topic: The Most Beautiful Equation: Unveiling Euler's Formula
target_audience: High school seniors or undergraduate students with a basic interest in mathematics and physics.

sections.title: The Gathering of Five Giants
lecture_lines: Mathematics has five fundamental constants that define our world.
Meet zero, one, e, pi, and the imaginary unit i.
Separately they seem unrelated, but one formula unites them.
animations: Display five symbols: 0 (#FFFFFF), 1 (#FFFFFF), e (#FFD700), pi (#ADD8E6), i (#FF69B4) arranged in a circle.
Scale up each symbol (0, 1, e, pi, i) sequentially and add small descriptive labels underneath.
Move the five symbols into a central horizontal alignment as if preparing for an equation.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Mystery of 'i' as a Rotation
lecture_lines: The imaginary unit i isn't just an impossible square root.
In geometry, multiplying by i signifies a 90-degree rotation.
It transforms flat numbers into dynamic directional vectors.
animations: Display the equation 'i = sqrt(-1)' (#FF69B4) in the center of the screen.
Draw a horizontal white arrow (#FFFFFF) and rotate it 90 degrees counter-clockwise to point upwards toward an 'i' label.
Repeat the 90-degree rotation from 'i' to point left, landing on a '-1' label (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: The Nature of 'e': Continuous Growth
lecture_lines: The constant e represents the limit of continuous growth.
Imagine a value growing at a 100% annual rate.
Compounding more frequently increases the final return slightly.
Compounding every instant leads us to the value e.
It is the base of all natural growth processes.
animations: Display the constant 'e' (#FFD700) with the label 'Base of Growth' (#FFFFFF).
Show a vertical bar of height 1 (#FFFFFF) and grow it to height 2.
Split the bar into multiple compounding segments, increasing its total height to 2.44.
Animate a smooth growth curve reaching height 2.718, labeled as 'e' (#FFD700).
Pulse the value 2.718 and the 'e' symbol to emphasize it as the natural limit.

sections.title: Euler's Formula: Growth Meets Rotation
lecture_lines: What happens when growth moves in an imaginary direction?
Multiplying growth by i turns our movement sideways.
Instead of expanding outward, we orbit in a circle.
This relationship is expressed by Euler's famous formula.
Growth becomes rotation on the complex unit circle.
animations: Show the expression 'e' with a blank exponent box (#FFFFFF). Fill the box with 'i' (#FF69B4).
Draw a unit circle (#555555) and a vector starting at (1,0). Show an 'i' force pushing the vector tip upwards.
Animate the vector tip tracing a blue arc (#00FFFF) along the perimeter of the unit circle.
Fade in 'e^{ix} = cos(x) + i sin(x)' above the circle with color-coded components.
Highlight the circle's boundary in gold (#FFD700) as the point completes a small rotation.

sections.title: The Grand Finale: e^(πi) = -1
lecture_lines: Let's set our rotation distance to the value pi.
Since pi is a half-circle, we rotate 180 degrees.
We start at positive one and swing around perfectly.
The journey ends exactly at the number negative one.
Thus, e raised to pi-i plus one equals zero.
animations: Display 'e^{ix}' and substitute 'x' with the symbol 'pi' (#ADD8E6).
Animate a point rotating 180 degrees along the unit circle arc, starting from 1.
The arc trace moves through 'i' at the top and continues until it hits the far left side.
The point lands on '-1' (#FFFFFF). Display the equation 'e^{pi i} = -1' in bold gold (#FFD700).
Animate the '-1' moving to the left side of the equals sign to form 'e^{pi i} + 1 = 0' (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Conclusion: The Unity of Math
lecture_lines: This elegant identity links algebra, geometry, and calculus.
It reveals a deep, hidden symmetry within the universe.
One line of ink connects the most fundamental concepts.
animations: Display the final identity 'e^{pi i} + 1 = 0' (#FFD700) in the center. Surround it with the labels 'Algebra', 'Geometry', and 'Calculus'.
Draw glowing lines (#FFFFFF) connecting each label to the central formula.
Fade out the labels and lines, leaving only the glowing formula 'e^{pi i} + 1 = 0' on a black background.
